name: Readable magical battlefield
description: Show enough of the battlefield to understand action and scale; retain dark, brooding atmosphere without hiding play.

traits.camera.goal: Current views are too zoomed. Show combat space, source, target and relevant threats together.
traits.compatibility.verification: Unverified; pinned inputs identify what must be checked together.
traits.generation.source: MarkovJunior inheritance is relevant; selecting exact world-generation rules is still open.
traits.lighting.goal: Keep spatial and energy silhouettes readable in both visual treatments.
traits.scale.goal: Make small and large forms legible; zord-like fighting scale is a user reference, not a new enemy specification.

notes: Design decision is separate from task completion, asset selection and implementation evidence. Reference images are on the off-path design-review board; no selected image anchor is asserted.
